mermaid:
flowchart TD
  subgraph Api["Opérations"]
    A["lib/ex_aws.ex"] --> B["lib/ex_aws/operation.ex"]
    B --> C["lib/ex_aws/operation/s3.ex"]
    B --> D["lib/ex_aws/operation/json.ex"]
  end
  subgraph Securite["Authentification"]
    E["lib/ex_aws/config.ex"] --> F["lib/ex_aws/auth/credentials.ex"]
    F --> G["lib/ex_aws/auth/signatures.ex"]
  end
  subgraph Transport["Requête HTTP"]
    H["lib/ex_aws/request.ex"] --> I["lib/ex_aws/request/hackney.ex"]
    H --> J["lib/ex_aws/request/req.ex"]
  end
  A --> E
  A --> H
  G --> H
explication: ExAws.request lit la configuration, résout les identifiants et signe l'opération avec signatures.ex. La requête est ensuite envoyée par un client HTTP interchangeable, Hackney ou Req.
source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: ExAws.request reads the configuration, resolves the credentials and signs the operation with signatures.ex. The request is then sent by an interchangeable HTTP client, Hackney or Req.
